## Corrected Actions runtime receipt — 2026-09-16
Candidate `1a663fc7eda778480ec858d30c90d2fac90796f2`, tree `1eb54a5e896a6b134d1d92fb1a504ed300b1f6a8`; base remains `bad0f1efe3525e8a75e9acb6cdea2bf1e404f1ae`.

Receipt classifications: `runtime=PASS`, `nested_agent=NOT_EVALUATED`, `typed_outcome_observed=false`, `authorizes_landing=false`, `local_carrier_verdict=NOT_EVALUATED`.
Artifact [noodle-actions-runtime-1a663fc7eda778480ec858d30c90d2fac90796f2-1](https://github.com/ed3c/noodle/actions/runs/35056849442/artifacts/10430243859); provider digest `sha256:e38ba746d267cb37c040f00dfd65e72063784c094454a58b036991fe853cc98b`. The actual JSON was read from the completed job log and artifact metadata was read back; archive bytes were not independently downloaded.

Exact-head local canonical `pnpm check` passed in 12.066s, source clean. However, [ordinary Test CI 35056849401](https://github.com/ed3c/noodle/actions/runs/35056849401) failed in the nested fixture suite: `TestProcessHandleSpawnAndDone` observed empty stdout instead of `hello\n`. This is preserved as separate dependency [#80](https://github.com/ed3c/noodle/issues/80); unchanged ProcessHandle source was not modified and no unchanged CI rerun was issued.

Current next owner actions: admit and resolve/dispose of #80 through its existing ProcessHandle owner; independently obtain the real successful typed-outcome evidence still required by #78. Missing OPENAI_API_KEY is not a runtime or supervised-Actions blocker. #78 stays open, PR #79 draft, and #18 has no new production admission. No merge/close or full Agent-cycle success is claimed.

## Current correction — API-key-only gate withdrawn
The owner correctly identified that API keys are not a prerequisite for Noodle runtime or the ChatGPT-supervised GitHub Actions path. The secret-presence gate introduced in the cloud envelope below was an incorrect admission rule. Its historical BLOCKED receipt describes that rule, not a Noodle runtime failure. It is superseded; do not request a model credential to enable ordinary Actions runtime verification.

Fresh execution envelope: same owner, branch/worktree, seven-file write boundary and rollback atom; resume from 7c8620a470d36981dd67b42dda31e0134aeb4bb3, base bad0f1efe3525e8a75e9acb6cdea2bf1e404f1ae. Replace the workflow's availability check with real candidate Noodle worktree creation, execution, missing-target refusal before side effects, cleanup and Git readback. Reuse worktree_probe from fixed external ed3c/soodles@0256f2923e978b989e25df07c74db4370d343312/soodles.py, SHA-256 d65b8ba15f2cdbfdd43c4fc0bf267c78ccb2b38208171623b1291704b144c6d9. Do not load the default branch verifier or promote a candidate verifier. Update the existing brain note with this correction.

Record runtime and nested Agent claims separately. The probe is non-authorizing and does not replace #78's original successful real Codex typed-outcome acceptance. No secret reads, model requests, host-policy changes, new scheduler or unaltered launch retry. Prior acceptance is invalid for the upcoming new head; run canonical acceptance once at the final provider candidate head and read back Actions results. Soodles #18's actual admission remains a separate owner decision; absent OPENAI_API_KEY is not its blocker.

## Observed blocker for Soodles target integration
Owner: Noodle's Codex process dispatch boundary. This is one launch-contract correction, not permission to alter host requirements or build another scheduler.

Physical runtime: ed3c/noodle v0.1.19, commit 391f3154c680fc6724b8cdabf6bcec831b61065d, binary SHA-256 9f1354bea227a5e71fa36260645fa6102f1474f9fba170f9a76ad9f6dd678472.
Latest source readback: bad0f1efe3525e8a75e9acb6cdea2bf1e404f1ae; dispatcher/command.go still unconditionally emits --dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox.

## Physical trigger
In the current managed carrier, /opt/codex/bin/codex --version returns codex-cli 0.154.0-alpha.3 and login status returns Logged in using ChatGPT. It is outside PATH; the probe added only /opt/codex/bin and the pinned Noodle directory to PATH. No authentication material or requirements were modified.

An isolated temporary Git fixture used routing.defaults provider=codex/model=gpt-5.6-sol, agents.codex args=[--ignore-user-config], require_typed_outcome=true, concurrency.max_concurrency=1, server.enabled=false and existing process runtime. Backlog fixture scripts were true/false; a capability-only probe skill/order was seeded. No schedule skill was present, so the real startup owner took its bootstrap route.

Invocation: /tmp/soodles-runtime/noodle start
A supervisor stopped its process group after 40 seconds, allowing graceful shutdown. Observed elapsed 40.028 seconds; exit 0 reflects shutdown, not successful work.

All three bootstrap session stderr.log records contain:
```
Error: `approval_policy = "never"` cannot be used because requirements do not allow `sandbox_mode = "danger-full-access"`; Codex would fall back to read-only permissions with approvals disabled. Choose an `approval_policy` based on what you need, such as `on-request`, or choose an allowed sandbox mode.
```
The three meta.json states are failed. No successful Agent execution or Issue admission was observed. Receipt SHA-256: 5f5400e96f37d699b98e8c35ff7df498719d796490a77663b94e6e266b158146.

## Cause / nearest source
dispatcher/command.go codexBaseArgs hardcodes exec + --dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox + --skip-git-repo-check + --json before dispatch.
The host requirements reject that policy combination. This is distinct from missing credentials and from the separate missing-schedule bootstrap behavior.

## Bounded correction
Use the existing host/repository-owned permitted launch contract, preserving actual host restrictions. Do not modify requirements.toml, permission controls or credentials to make the command pass; do not introduce an Agent-facing authority-policy selector, guessed fallback or unchanged retries.
Include the argument producer, relevant dispatch consumer/capability diagnostic and nearest positive/planted-negative tests necessary for this one correction. Precise file boundary and acceptance must be admitted by this repository's owner before execution.

## Acceptance
Re-read latest source and reproduce on an affected carrier. A permitted host configuration must launch a real Codex session through Noodle and obtain the existing typed outcome; a forbidden configuration must produce an actionable blocked/refused result naming the invalid field/value and supported next entry before task side effects. Preserve existing worktree/dispatch ownership and canonical pnpm check. Prove with runtime receipts; fixtures alone cannot establish authenticated Agent execution.

## Non-claims / dependency handling
This is a reported exact dependency, not a source-authorized ready task or an execution envelope. Soodles has not modified this repository's lifecycle or code. Its integration remains blocked pending a verified runtime capability or a separately admitted compatible release.
The same fixture also emitted 9,217 bootstrap-exhausted warnings after the three failures; that is separate loop-owner evidence and is not included in this launch-policy patch. No broad retry/loop redesign belongs here.

## Execution checkpoint — 2026-09-16
The repository owner explicitly requested completing #78 and then resuming Soodles #18 in the supervising session. This authorizes isolated implementation of this atom, not authority-policy changes or a production scheduler claim.

Source base: bad0f1efe3525e8a75e9acb6cdea2bf1e404f1ae. Noodle-created worktree: .worktrees/issue-78-codex-launch; branch issue-78-codex-launch.

Exact initial write boundary: dispatcher/command.go, dispatcher/process_dispatcher.go, dispatcher/process_session.go, dispatcher/sprites_dispatcher.go, dispatcher/codex_launch_test.go, brain/codebase/codex-launch-carrier-contract.md. Include only changes needed for the shared argv producer, process consumer/diagnostic, existing Sprite caller compatibility and discriminating controls. The current external acceptance source and host requirements stay fixed. No candidate acceptance exists yet; any widened boundary requires a new checkpoint and invalidation.

Compatibility scope: ordinary ChatGPT GitHub plugin transport plus Actions runtime tests does not require a nested Codex Agent. Local or Actions Noodle-to-Codex execution must use its own allowed host configuration and available model authentication; GitHub connector access does not establish this capability. Do not treat the carrier rejection as failure of Soodles' already demonstrated supervised delivery route.

Pre-edit probe removed the forced bypass and retained host configuration: codex exec --json --ephemeral --model gpt-5.6-sol with a no-tool capability prompt. It timed out after 55.012 seconds with no Agent events (stderr only Reading additional input from stdin...). This is not a successful launch receipt. Do not retry that unchanged input.

This checkpoint supersedes only the earlier report-only implementation status. Production scheduling remains unadmitted, and all original real-runtime and canonical acceptance requirements remain outstanding.

## Verified implementation checkpoint — Draft PR #79
Candidate: 2a9d7a9c1687563abd8c511b98bf223945cd2932; tree: 1c0c64c78484a2838fcad67e49ff38bd62010beb; base remains bad0f1efe3525e8a75e9acb6cdea2bf1e404f1ae.
PR: https://github.com/ed3c/noodle/pull/79 (draft; not merged).

Implemented inside the admitted boundary: process launches no longer receive an implicit permission override; Sprite preserves its existing carrier argv; pre-event Codex errors retain the exact field/value and `codex exec --help` in the terminal outcome after stderr persistence. No lifecycle classification, retry owner, credentials, host requirements or active verifier was changed.

Evidence:
- Focused RED→GREEN; dispatcher suite and focused race controls passed.
- Planted forced-permission injection, diagnostic loss and Sprite policy drift were each rejected.
- Real installed Codex through the candidate process dispatcher rejected `invalid-mode` for `--sandbox` before Agent events; outcome now names the owning configuration action and `codex exec --help`. Noodle cleanup succeeded.
- Canonical `pnpm check` passed at the exact provider head in 12.195s, with a clean worktree. An earlier pre-transport head with the identical tree passed in 55.571s; the second acceptance was required because connector transport changed commit identity. These times are not a performance comparison.
- GitHub Actions Test run 35054935096 / attempt 1, job 104662992744, succeeded for head 2a9d7a9c1687563abd8c511b98bf223945cd2932: https://github.com/ed3c/noodle/actions/runs/35054935096 . Test, Vet, architecture lint and skill snapshot passed.

Remaining blocker: the real permitted-config process probe emitted no Agent events in 90s and was cancelled; Noodle cleanup then succeeded. Direct probes on installed Codex 0.154.0-alpha.3 (55s) and 0.153.3 (120s) also timed out. Successful Agent executions=0; typed outcomes=0; production Issue admissions=0. Do not infer a credential cause from these observations. Ordinary plugin transport + Actions checks works, but does not prove nested Agent execution.

Checkpoint classification: BLOCKED, not RESOLVED. Keep #78 open, #79 draft and Soodles #18 unadmitted. Preserve the committed implementation worktree for resumption. No unchanged launch retry. Next admissible step is a materially changed and authorized carrier capability, or a demonstrated fix to the pre-event startup failure, followed by real typed completion and the existing delivery gates.

Evidence file: noodle-78-compatibility-checkpoint-20260916.json; SHA-256 7a542a3650b1413212808adb63ae37fcb341c5aea17e26c3af3f402c93dcda87. It includes raw probe/session receipts, cleanup, planted-negative outputs, both local acceptance logs and the provider CI log. No landing authority is granted by this checkpoint.

## Historical cloud-first envelope — superseded by correction above
The owner explicitly separated GitHub Actions evidence from local/managed Codex CLI evidence and requested proving Actions first. Cloud success will establish only the exact Actions carrier; the earlier managed-carrier timeout remains a separate unresolved observation and is not a prerequisite for running the cloud experiment.

Amend the same #78 atom's write boundary to add `.github/workflows/codex-actions-capability.yml`; retain the six previously admitted files. Resume the same Noodle worktree and PR #79 from candidate 2a9d7a9c1687563abd8c511b98bf223945cd2932 and source base bad0f1efe3525e8a75e9acb6cdea2bf1e404f1ae. Prior acceptance applies only to the old head and cannot authorize this new envelope.

First cloud discriminator: a same-repository PR workflow, with no candidate checkout or execution, checks only the boolean availability of the documented `secrets.OPENAI_API_KEY` input. Never expose or copy the secret value. Bind the receipt to Actions run/attempt, workflow SHA and candidate head. Missing input is BLOCKED before Agent dispatch; available input is AUTH_INPUT_AVAILABLE, not authenticated execution or success. No alternate credential identity is guessed and no host or repository permission is changed.

If the input is available, admit the exact additional probe/observer files before the next mutation, then run the real Noodle process path on Actions with model auth isolated from candidate code. Preserve a fixed external observer, actual session/order/stage typed outcome and Noodle cleanup. If unavailable, preserve this exact cloud blocker and do not run a known unauthenticated retry. Do not infer that all possible authentication methods or all repository secrets are absent.

This experiment is non-authorizing. #78 remains open and #79 draft until actual Agent execution and the unchanged delivery acceptance are satisfied. Soodles #18 remains contingent on those receipts.

## Historical receipt — incorrect API-key-only admission rule
Head: 7c8620a470d36981dd67b42dda31e0134aeb4bb3. Cloud run: https://github.com/ed3c/noodle/actions/runs/35055962345 (attempt 1), job 104666104364. Actual cloud result: `BLOCKED`, field `secrets.OPENAI_API_KEY.available`, value `false`, owner `Actions Codex authentication`. Preflight and artifact publication succeeded; the final refusal step deliberately exited 1 before Agent dispatch. No checkout, secret value, model request or local CLI probe was used. Agent execution attempted=false; typed outcome observed=false; landing authority=false. This establishes only that the documented input was unavailable in this workflow context, not that all possible repository authentication methods are absent.

Artifact 10430990790, digest sha256:ffcf328fdad42ea191a3e7c7970bbda2fdb877e7acbdc600b584f34fa3cef655, was read back from GitHub metadata. The receipt itself was read from the job log. noodle80.body:
## Physical failure
Observed while verifying Noodle PR #79, candidate `1a663fc7eda778480ec858d30c90d2fac90796f2`, tree `1eb54a5e896a6b134d1d92fb1a504ed300b1f6a8`, base `bad0f1efe3525e8a75e9acb6cdea2bf1e404f1ae`.

[Actions Test run 35056849401](https://github.com/ed3c/noodle/actions/runs/35056849401), attempt 1, [job 104668717896](https://github.com/ed3c/noodle/actions/runs/35056849401/job/104668717896):
```
--- FAIL: TestFixtureSuitesDoNotMutateFixtureFiles (27.84s)
    fixtures_immutability_test.go:27: run fixture suites: exit status 1
        --- FAIL: TestProcessHandleSpawnAndDone (0.01s)
            process_test.go:23: stdout = "", want "hello\n"
        FAIL github.com/poteto/noodle/dispatcher
```
The outer dispatcher suite in the same job passed; the nested fixture suite failed. Exact-head local canonical `pnpm check` passed in 12.066s. This is an observed intermittent failure, not permission to retry unchanged CI or suppress the test.

## Owner and causal boundary
Owner: the existing dispatcher ProcessHandle child-stream and wait lifecycle. This is independently reversible from #78's Codex permission-argument/launch-diagnostic correction. `dispatcher/process.go`, `dispatcher/process_test.go`, and `fixtures_immutability_test.go` are unchanged between the candidate and base.

Source evidence: StartProcess creates Cmd.StdoutPipe/StderrPipe, starts the child, then launches h.wait immediately; h.wait calls cmd.Wait independently of stream consumption. The test reads stdout after StartProcess returns and discards the read error. The installed Go 1.25.14 os/exec contract requires pipe reads to finish before Wait closes pipes. Premature pipe closure is a source-supported causal hypothesis; do not claim that every no-event session or timeout shares this cause.

## Required correction and acceptance
Obtain a fresh repository-owned execution envelope before changing source. Use a bounded deterministic control that forces child exit before delayed stdout/stderr consumption, preserves the actual read error, and discriminates lost bytes. Include all required stream producers, consumers, wait/close compatibility and tests within this one ProcessHandle atom. Preserve exit-code, cancellation, ForceKill, unread-stream and large-output behavior without deadlocks or unbounded buffering. Exact write boundary must follow the observed consumers; do not split by helper or introduce a retry framework.

Positive control must retain expected output after a fast child exit; a planted old wait/close ordering must fail. Keep fixture immutability protection and full canonical acceptance. Run canonical once per final candidate head, then exact-head Actions verification, existing landing and reconciliation. Do not delete/skip the failing test, add sleeps to hide the race, reduce assertions, or rerun unchanged to get green.

## Dependency and next owner action
This failure blocks delivery of PR #79 until an accepted correction or precise evidence-based disposition exists. It does not block the already successful no-model-credential [Noodle worktree Actions runtime](https://github.com/ed3c/noodle/actions/runs/35056849442).

Reported dependency only; no ready label, Claim, execution envelope or production order has been created. Let the existing Noodle owner schedule it after admission. No ProcessHandle source was changed from the current #78 lane. Open- and closed-Issue title readback found no matching existing atom.

## Current correction — supervised Actions does not require an API key
The API-key-only preflight introduced under Noodle #78 was an incorrect admission rule. Run 35055962345 never executed Noodle; its historical BLOCKED result does not establish an Actions runtime failure. It is superseded, and the model-authentication prerequisite in the historical cloud checkpoint below is withdrawn for the ChatGPT-supervised Actions path.

Noodle PR #79 now removes that gate at head 1a663fc7eda778480ec858d30c90d2fac90796f2 and runs the fixed external Soodles worktree control without model credentials: https://github.com/ed3c/noodle/actions/runs/35056849442 . Provider readback: PASS, attempt 1, job 104668718077, 13 transcript commands and zero residue. Runtime PASS; nested Agent NOT_EVALUATED; no landing authority. The workflow supplied no model credential. Ordinary Test CI separately failed on fast-exit stdout loss; exact dependency ed3c/noodle#80 preserves that failure. No unchanged rerun was made.

This correction does not claim production Issue admission or nested Agent completion. #18 still requires its own exact adapter admission and real dispatch/delivery receipts. Noodle worktree runtime, supervised delivery, and nested Noodle→Codex inference are distinct capabilities; do not make a specific model-authentication method a blanket prerequisite. No Soodles source, runtime pin, order or lifecycle transition was changed.

## Goal and owner
One Soodles target-adapter atom: an explicitly admitted real Soodles Issue becomes exactly one Noodle order, enters the matching Noodle-owned worktree, completes the existing provider handoff and supervised delivery, and ends with a receipted terminal classification.

Current base: 0256f2923e978b989e25df07c74db4370d343312.
Status: BLOCKED before production admission. This Issue is not ready and does not authorize another retry.

## Exact dependency
Depends on ed3c/noodle#78: the pinned Noodle process dispatcher unconditionally requests a Codex approval/sandbox combination rejected by this carrier's requirements. Codex is installed and ChatGPT login is present; no new credential or GitHub Administration permission is requested. The dependency must be resolved through its owner, or an already-authorized compatible carrier must be physically demonstrated.

## Observed evidence
Pinned Noodle v0.1.19 / 391f3154c680fc6724b8cdabf6bcec831b61065d.
An isolated real noodle start probe reached three failed Codex bootstrap sessions. Each rejected approval_policy=never with sandbox_mode=danger-full-access under host requirements. A bounded supervisor stopped it after 40.028 seconds and retained session/order evidence. Exit 0 was graceful shutdown, not success. Receipt SHA-256 5f5400e96f37d699b98e8c35ff7df498719d796490a77663b94e6e266b158146.

The fixture lacked a schedule skill and exercised bootstrap, not a production Issue dispatch. No fake provider or scripted Agent was substituted. Thus it cannot establish a successful Issue cycle or lower Agent decision cost.

## Intended same-atom write boundary after fresh admission
Soodles-owned target adapter/CLI producer and consumer, Noodle configuration wiring, repository-local schedule and soodles-issue-execute skills, nearest positive/planted-negative runtime controls and necessary AGENTS/system contract updates. Define exact files and binding in a fresh execution envelope after capability is proven. Do not modify the Noodle dispatcher from a Soodles lane.

## Required behavior
- Validate exact Issue/repository/body revision/authorization/write boundary before scheduling and again before worker effects.
- Materialize only the existing orders-next input. Noodle retains canonical orders, single ownership, runtime and worktree lifecycle.
- An already-owned Issue does not gain a second order. Skill resolution binds the exact local path/digests.
- Execute consumes owner-provided next actions and existing typed outcomes. Stage completion is not provider merge/Issue closure.
- Reuse existing canonical acceptance and the fixed external publisher; no candidate self-promotion, guessed policy, new scheduler or general retry engine.
- Include producer/consumer/adapter/controls required for this one correction; do not split by helper/file.

## Acceptance
One actual admitted Issue through real Agent dispatch, worktree, exact-head verification, PR handoff, merge/close readback and Noodle reconciliation. Controls reject duplicate/stale/foreign input and preserve crash evidence. A missing capability is BLOCKED, not a successful fixture substitute.

## Following stages remain contingent
After this atom is physically complete: observed dynamic dependency/concurrency controls; expand the existing verify-soodles map and perform full pstack maintenance; then matched Agent execution traces under fixed task/model/environment/acceptance conditions. Do not create speculative feature recipes or claim decision-cost reduction from command count alone.

## Dependency checkpoint — 2026-09-16
Noodle #78 has an isolated implementation in draft PR ed3c/noodle#79 at 2a9d7a9c1687563abd8c511b98bf223945cd2932. Focused/race/planted-negative controls, exact-head local canonical acceptance and Actions Test run 35054935096 passed. The real invalid-sandbox refusal now exposes the exact invalid field/value and supported help.

This does not satisfy the dependency's positive Agent execution requirement: the permitted-config Noodle process probe emitted no Agent events in 90 seconds and was cancelled, with successful fixture cleanup. No typed outcome or production Issue admission was observed. #78 remains open and #79 remains draft. Therefore this Issue remains BLOCKED before production admission; no Soodles source, pin, skills, feature map, orders or daemon were changed. Base remains 0256f2923e978b989e25df07c74db4370d343312.

Resume only after materially changed, authorized capability produces a real successful Noodle-to-Codex execution receipt and #78 meets its remaining delivery requirements. Do not rerun unchanged bootstrap input or substitute CI/unit success for Agent execution.

Evidence: noodle-78-compatibility-checkpoint-20260916.json, SHA-256 7a542a3650b1413212808adb63ae37fcb341c5aea17e26c3af3f402c93dcda87; draft: https://github.com/ed3c/noodle/pull/79 .

## Historical cloud-first readback — authentication prerequisite corrected above
Cloud and local Codex requirements are independent. The managed-carrier timeout is not a prerequisite for proving Actions.

Noodle PR #79 head 7c8620a470d36981dd67b42dda31e0134aeb4bb3 passed canonical acceptance and ordinary Test CI. Its actual Actions capability run 35055962345 returned BLOCKED: `secrets.OPENAI_API_KEY.available=false` in that workflow context; receipt artifact 10430990790 was published. No cloud Agent dispatch or typed outcome was attempted. See https://github.com/ed3c/noodle/actions/runs/35055962345 .

This Issue remains unadmitted until authorized cloud model authentication and a real Noodle→Codex completion/cleanup receipt exist, followed by #78 delivery. No Soodles source, runtime pin, skill or lifecycle state was modified. Do not retry unchanged cloud input or use local timeout as cloud failure evidence.

## Shared admission contract requirement — 2026-09-16
This is a requirement refinement, not execution admission or evidence of implementation. Latest inspected Soodles source: 6bed718e915ba13e7d2536bb926eea2a9138fbce. Historical carrier receipts above retain their own source boundaries.

Automatic scheduling and supervised fallback must consume the same repository-owned Issue admission contract and canonical acceptance. Do not add an Agent-selected authority-policy/mode flag or a parallel scheduler.
- One Issue body format: causal trigger/source SHA; owner and reversible boundary; exact admitted writes; required behavior and positive/planted-negative controls; exact dependencies/blockers; canonical acceptance/provider/reconciliation requirements; feature-map coverage and non-claims.
- Before order creation or supervised execution and again before worker effects, validate the same Issue repository/number/body revision, authorization and write boundary. Missing, malformed, foreign or stale fields must fail before effects and name the precise field/value and the owning next input/readback.
- Read back provider writes with unknown outcomes before retry. Automatic-to-supervised handoff must retain the original claim/checkpoint/offered-write history; it must not create a duplicate order or re-offer a write.
- Both routes retain final-head canonical acceptance, exact-head provider checks, explicit fixed external judge selection, merge/closure readback and Noodle reconciliation. Route-specific integration evidence is additional; a fixture or supervised success cannot prove autonomous execution.
- Both consume the same verify-soodles feature map. Include new surfaces only after physical proof, then perform full pstack maintain-verification-skill. The skill does not own or duplicate the admission validator.
- Acceptance must demonstrate both entry surfaces consume the same validator, invalid/stale input is rejected before side effects, and legal automatic-to-supervised recovery preserves identity/history. Existing production-dispatch requirements remain in force.

No new source, runtime pin, order or lifecycle state is authorized by this amendment. Status remains BLOCKED before production admission; do not retry an unchanged carrier. Dependency #78/#80 resolution must be read back through their owner before claiming readiness.
